correctness.rationale: Exact ETDRK2 recurrence reconstructed from phi-functions. With \(q=H(1-z)\) and \(B\le H\le1\), positivity follows from \(z(3+3q+q^2)\le3\). The remaining upper-squared-energy bound reduces exactly to \(P=(2-z(1+W^2))/(1-z)\ge1/8\) on the unit cube, verified via a complete 729-coefficient rational Bernstein certificate in the standalone standard-library proof checker. The exact energy factorization yields descent; the derivative at \(u=1\) tends to \((1-2/\alpha)^2>1\) for every \(0<\alpha<1\) (and explicit Heun \(\alpha=0\) gives a multiplier greater than one for \(h>1\)), producing strict energy-increasing interior starts. Checked script exits with VERIFY_OK. Applies only to the specified one-step input interval.

value.rationale: A sharp stabilizer frontier for a named widely studied second-order energy-dissipative exponential integrator on the canonical scalar quartic double well is operationally meaningful: \(\alpha\ge1\) is universally single-step energy safe for bounded starts, whereas every smaller alpha fails at sufficiently large h. The certificate is structural, not an isolated numeric parameter choice. The overshoot example explicitly rules out conflating energy descent with a maximum-bound principle; this fact informs correct use of conditional-step energy arguments.
